bio_am: Բուն անունով Յարութիւն Սարգիսեան, ծնած է Տարօնի Փեթար գիւղը 1874-5-ին։ Մասնակցած է Սասնոյ 1894-ի եւ 1904-ի կռիւներուն, իսկ մահացած է Հալէպ՝ 1967 Հոկտեմբեր 1-ին։
bio_en: Born Harutyun Sargsyan in the village of Petar in Taron around 1874-75, Keri Tado became the first member of Hrayr's band in his village and joined the ARF after Hrayr established it in Taron and Sasun in late 1894. He fought beside his father in the first Sasun uprising of 1894 and later in the band of Ishkhan Peto. In 1904 the band of Sasuntsi Manuk joined Gevorg Chavush, and Keri Tado survived the 1915 resistance in Sasun. After Sovietisation he hid in the mountains with Peto Ghazar's men until 1929, left with a group of 38 for Tehran in 1930, and died in an old people's home in Aleppo on 1 October 1967.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: high. Birth given as 1874-5 in the archive; 1874 used. Source text is 'Revolutionary Album' 1917 no. 9, edited with later additions (death 1967).
